meta.expect: goes cold; sets the teacher back

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it: who decided my son gets a zero, and why did he find out from his phone in the middle of class?
You're welcome. Now answer the question.
I know your family has a history with academic integrity at this school. Claire's case.

You'll want to be very careful about the next sentence, Hale. Claire's case has nothing to do with Owen, and the fact that you brought it up before you showed me a single piece of evidence tells me exactly how this zero happened. Keep going and we continue this in the principal's office.
Maybe this runs in the family.
"Runs in the family." I'm writing that down, word for word, with the time. You've got one chance to show me something with a date on it, or I'm going upstairs and the board hears that sentence too.
